author: Parker Rehm
title: Lady Jaguars pounce on Pantherettes, Midway drops game one - NewsBreak
text:
By Parker Rehm ,
1 hours ago ALVARADO, Texas ( FOX 44 ) — For the second-straight year, Midway softball will play from behind in the state semifinal after dropping the first game of the series against Flower Mound, 4-0 on Wednesday night.
Peyton Philipp provided a spark in the circle for the Bears, not allowing a hit through the first three innings but the Lady Jaguars broke through in the sixth, plating four runs to take the lead after loading the bases.
Midway falls behind in the series and takes to game two tomorrow with a chance to tie it up. First pitch is slated for Thursday, May 21st at 6:00 p.m. at Alvarado High School.
